{"id":1988261106,"question_id":4270,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1777173139,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1988261106/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Operations to Make Array Non Decreasing","memory":"137 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    long long minOperations(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n\n        ll ans = 0;\n        ll prev_need = 0;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n-1 ; i++){\n            int curr_need = max(0LL , (nums[i] + prev_need) - nums[i+1]);\n\n            if(curr_need > prev_need){\n                ans += (curr_need - prev_need);\n            }\n            prev_need = curr_need;\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-operations-to-make-array-non-decreasing","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1944}
